Careers with Atriis

Atriis provides the technology that enables travel management companies (TMCs) and corporate clients to manage all their travel needs quickly, intuitively and cost-effectively. From seamless links with airline booking systems, to the largest range of hotel inventory, our technology provides the best possible customer experience, reducing complexity, time and cost.

We are now embarking on a transformational change and growth programme tailored specifically to provide solutions to our clients’ current and future needs. Our success is linked directly to the success and growth of our existing and new customers, and we align all our expertise, internal processes, sales, engineering and implementation skills to achieve this.

Our leadership team sets the vision, purpose and direction, and then allows you the freedom to perform at your best – wherever you’re working – with support when you need it. We encourage innovation and ideas which fit with our values and always impact customer success.  At ease with real accountability, you’ll own your contributions and their success, but still recognising the importance of collaboration and supporting your colleagues.

Our standards of selection are high, and we carefully consider not only relevant technical skills, but also attitudes, values and culture fit. If you match up, we offer a genuinely exciting and transformational career path.

Our salaries and benefits packages are competitive in each local market.

So scroll down to view our current range of live opportunities. If there’s one that fits with your experience and ambition, then apply now as speed is of the essence. If there isn’t, then we still want to hear from you so email your CV to us at hr@atriis.com
